conditioningLevel.rationale: High: C2 met - early silicone Dimethicone@6, cationic polymer Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride@8, pearlizing route Glycol Distearate@3 and a deliberate humectant entry Sodium Hyaluronate@13; supporting late Amodimethicone@23. wLine.plausibility: (i) Sodium Laureth Sulfate@2 before it; (ii) no cleansing surfactant (Trideceth-n and Steareth-6 are in no C3 cleansing class), no alkanolamide (Cocamide MEA@9 is before it) and no pearlizing wax after it before the cap

Not low: the early silicone + guar system is plausible enough that calling it lightweight would understate residue.
